name: View Filter
tagline: A search box that filters the view server-side.

limitations: Searching narrows nothing here, and that is the whole of what this control does. Filtering is server-side: the control calls dataset.filtering.setFilter() and then refresh(), which on a real view sends the query and returns a different set of records. The demo harness has no server behind it — it treats a filter request the way it treats a sort request, by accepting it and rendering the same rows. Everything the control does up to that point is real and visible in the call log: the debounce, the expression it builds, the paging reset.

Paging is inert for the same reason. The harness puts every fixture record on a single page and reports hasNextPage and hasPreviousPage as false, so Previous and Next render disabled. The page size property does nothing either, because the harness’s setPageSize() is an empty function.

The filtered record count output therefore never changes. On a real view it follows totalResultCount, which is the server’s count of what matched; here totalResultCount is the fixture length whatever is typed.

Clicking a record calls dataset.openDatasetItem(), which the harness logs as a mock call: there is no Dataverse behind this origin and no form to open. The openedRecordId output still updates, so the value a canvas app would react to is visible.

What does work is everything that never leaves the browser: the search box keeps what you type across every render, Clear empties it, the minimum-character threshold is observable, and a view with no text column to search disables the box and says so.

presets.name: Default
presets.description: Eight accounts with a search box over them. Type and watch the call log below: the expression, the paging reset and the refresh are all real, and only the server behind them is missing.

presets.name: Contains, one column
presets.description: Matching anywhere in the value rather than at the start, and only over the account name — the setting that keeps a search off every text column of a large table.

presets.name: No pause, no threshold
presets.description: One character is enough and there is no typing pause, so every keystroke is a query. Useful for seeing what the debounce is for.

presets.name: Compact, read-only
presets.description: One detail line and records that do not open — the shape for a form section rather than a full page.
